newsitem.title: UK: StanChart says to restructure metals trade.
newsitem.headline: StanChart says to restructure metals trade.

text.p: Standard Chartered Plc said on Monday it had decided to merge its Mocatta Base Metals and Mocatta Bullion businesses under Nigel Dentoom who is appointed chief executive.
Dentoom wll be directly responsible for the base metals operation while Tim Jones becomes Chief Executive, Bullion, succeeding Sal Busacca who will be leaving Mocatta after 22 years.
The news follows newspaper reports that Standard Chartered was about to sell the Mocatta as it did not fit well with its core, mainly Far Eastern retail and corporate banking operations.
StanChart has largely pulled out of investment banking and earlier this year sold its private banking business.
The bank said it did not comment on market rumours. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
